title: 정확히 목표량인 로그 구간 수
prompt: Create ONE flat 2D educational vector-like diagram, landscape3:2. Solid warm ivory background, crisp charcoal outlines, deep teal highlighting, muted coral excluded values. No3D, no texture, no shadows, no decoration. Large legible exact ASCII labels. Clear three columns headed INPUT, OPERATION, OUTPUT. INPUT shows exactly three equal array cells containing 1, -1, 1 and label target = 1. OPERATION shows exactly THREE separate rows, each repeats those same three cells: row1 highlights ONLY the first 1 in teal and has sum = 1; row2 highlights ALL THREE cells 1,-1,1 in teal and has sum = 1; row3 highlights ONLY the final 1 in teal and has sum = 1. All unselected cells pale gray. This demonstrates three distinct contiguous subarrays. OUTPUT displays large 3 and label matching ranges. Thin arrows connect INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. Mathematical fidelity and large readable numbers are paramount. No other content.

title: 최소 재시도 비용 경로
prompt: Create ONE flat2D vector educational diagram, landscape3:2, solid ivory background, crisp charcoal outlines, teal chosen path, muted coral rejected path. NO3D, NOshadows, NOtexture, NOdecoration. Large clean ASCII text. Three panels INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. INPUT: directed weighted graph with exactly4 circular vertices:0 at left,2 at bottom-middle,1 at top-middle,3 at right. Exactly4 directed arrows:0->1 weight8 (coral),0->2 weight2(teal),2->1 weight1(teal, upward),1->3 weight3(teal). Weight labels beside edges clearly. OPERATION: two lines: '0 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3' and '2 + 1 + 3 = 6' in teal; below '0 -> 1 -> 3' and '8 + 3 = 11' in coral. OUTPUT: very large '6', small 'minimum cost'. All arrows on graph must point the correct direction, no other edges. Mathematical correctness is paramount.

title: 의존 작업 실행 순서
prompt: ONE flat2D educational vector diagram landscape3:2. Solid warm ivory background, crisp charcoal outlines, teal highlights, muted coral exclusions; absolutely no3D texture shadows or decorative objects. Large readable ASCII numerals. Three panels INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. INPUT contains exactly4 circles labeled0,1,2,3. Exactly TWO arrows:0->2 and1->2. Circle3 isolated with NO edges. OPERATION shows four stacked precise text rows: 'ready [0,1,3] : pick 0', 'ready [1,3] : pick 1', 'ready [2,3] : pick 2', 'ready [3] : pick 3'. Highlight picked values teal. OUTPUT shows large array '[0, 1, 2, 3]' and caption 'smallest valid order'. Diagram illustrates topological sorting always picking smallest ready task. No extra arrows or values; prioritize mathematical accuracy and legibility.

title: 최소 작업 패키지 수
prompt: ONE flat2D vector-like educational diagram landscape3:2, solid ivory background, crisp charcoal lines, teal selected, muted coral rejected. No3D no shadow no texture no decorative objects. Three panels INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. INPUT shows three simple square tokens labeled1,3,4 and text 'target = 6'. OPERATION shows a teal row of two square tokens '3' '+' '3' '=' '6', beneath label '2 packages'; below a coral row '4' '+' '1' '+' '1' '=' '6', beneath label '3 packages'. title: 인접 작업을 피한 최대 이익
prompt: ONE flat2D vector educational diagram, landscape3:2. Solid ivory background, crisp charcoal outlines, deep teal selection, muted coral exclusion. No3D, texture, shadows, decorative objects. Three panels INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. INPUT shows exactly5 adjacent square array cells reading '2', '7', '9', '3', '1'. OPERATION repeats the same5cells in sameorder: first2, third9 and fifth1 highlighted teal; second7 and fourth3 pale coral with small Xmarks beneath them. Caption 'No adjacent selections'. title: 격자에서 가능한 배포 경로 수
prompt: ONE flat2D vector educational diagram landscape3:2. Solid ivory, crisp charcoal grid lines, teal routes, muted coral blocked cell. No3D texture shadows decoration. Three panels INPUT -> OPERATION -> OUTPUT. INPUT exact3by3 grid with cell values rows '0 0 0', '0 1 0', '0 0 0'; center1 coral, all0 ivory. OPERATION shows TWO separate exact3by3 grids side by side, each center cell coral X. First grid route teal arrows connects cell centers top-left -> top-middle -> top-right -> middle-right -> bottom-right. Second grid route teal arrows connects top-left -> middle-left -> bottom-left -> bottom-middle -> bottom-right. Only right or down moves. Caption 'right or down only'. OUTPUT huge teal '2', caption 'valid paths'. No third route, no diagonal, no center crossing. Layout prioritize exact3rows3columns, complete arrows, readable labels.
